watches.name: Mirrored Force Resonance Ice Blue
watches.description: Armin Strom Releases the Mirrored Force Resonance Ice Blue Ice Blue sunrays. Only with us. For the first time, the off-center dial of the Mirrored Force Resonance Ice Blue features a sunray guilloché pattern. The lines radiating from the dial’s center are decorated using a traditional hand-operated rose engine lathe. The ice blue dial playfully catches and reflects light, creating an even more vibrant and deep view under the sapphire crystal. The new indexes and hands are beveled and polished, adding even more movement to the compelling design. On the left side of the dial, the resonance mechanism takes centre stage: two balances oscillating in opposite directions, connected by Armin Strom’s patented clutch. Two second counters confirm the synchronization of the balances. The anthracite-coloured bridges, surrounded by a 43 mm stainless steel case, remains discreetly in the background as if admiring the composition of the elements. A dark blue Alcantara strap gives the watch a refined look.

watches.name: Orbit Manufacture Edition
watches.description: We complicated the date function. Just to make it more easy-going. Most watches force their dates upon you. Whether you want it or not, the date (hopefully) ticks over every day at midnight and you are reminded that yet another day has vanished. The Orbit Manufacture Edition makes a difference in that regard. And that’s because it politely waits to be asked before showing you the date. watches.name: Mirrored Force Resonance Manufacture Edition Green
watches.description: How we mastered the impossible tick. The Mirrored Force Resonance Manufacture Edition Green is our take on a fascinating watchmaking phenomenon: resonance. This physical effect has captivated watchmakers since the 17th century. It occurs when two balances oscillate next to each other. They then regulate each other through their emitted vibrations. In theory, this produces significantly more reliable timing rates, aka greater chronometric stability. In reality, and especially in watches, maintaining resonance is very challenging. Wrist movements or minor shocks can easily disrupt it. We created our patented system to solve this problem. It makes resonance more stable and less prone to disturbances. With this, we have achieved something rare: introducing reliability into the unpredictable world of physics.
